chapter.verse: Topa aw, nangmah kong bel hi; keimah hong zahhuaisak ngei kei in!
Na thumanna tawh keimah hong gum in la hong honkhia in; kei lamah na bil hong ngat in la hong hon in!
Nangmah in hong hon dingin ka belh suangpi, ka kulh muan’huai hong hi ta in, bang hang hiam cih leh nangmah in keima suangpi leh ka kulhpi na hi hi.
Ka Pasian aw, migilote khutsung pan leh, thuman lote leh migilote’ matna panin keimah hong hon in.
Topa aw, bang hang hiam cih leh ka neu lai-a kipanin nangmah in keima lametna, ka muan’na na hi hi, Topa aw.
Ka suah tunga kipanin nangmah kong bel hi, ka nu’ gil sung panin hong lakhia-pa na hi hi. Nangmah kong phat ngitnget hi.
Mi tampi’ adingin sia-hil bang ka hih hangin nangmah in a muan’huai keima belh na hi hi.
Sunthapai-in nangmah kong phat a, na minthan’na ka gen tawntung hi.
Teek hun ciangin keimah hong lawnkhia kei in la, ka thakiat ciangin kei hong nusia kei in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh ka galte kiho-in, kei hong thah nopna thu kikum uh hi.
“Pasian in amah nusia zo hi; amah a hon ding om lo ahih ciangin delh-in man ni,” kici uh hi.
Pasian aw, kei kiang panin gamla om kei in; ka Pasian aw, keimah huh dingin hong manlang in!
Kei hong mawhsakte zahhuai-in beimang uh hen la, keima siat nading a zongte, simmawhna leh minsiatna in tuamcip ta hen.
Ahih hangin ke’n nang kong lamen-en dinga, nangmah kong phat semsem lai ding hi.
Thuman tawh na hotkhiatna nasepnate sim zawh lohin tam ahih manin sunthapai-in ka gengen ding hi.
T opa Pasian aw, na nasepna liante ka phat ding a, na thumanna bek genin ka nei ding hi.
Pasian aw, ka khangno lai-a kipanin nong thuhilh a, a lamdang na nasepnate ka gengen lai hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Pasian aw, hong piang lai ding mite khempeuh tungah nangma hatna ka gen khit matengin, teek-a ka sam a kaan’ hun ciang dong nangawn-in kei hong nusia kei in.
Pasian aw, na vangliatna leh na thumanna in van sangpite ban hi. Pasian aw, na lianpipi na sem khin zo hi, nang tawh a kibang kua om ahi hiam?
Gimna lianpipite hong tuaksak nangmah in keimah nong hing kiksak ding a, lei thukpi sung panin nong lakhiato kik ding hi.
Nangmah in ka min hoihna nong khang sak ding a, nong nuamtuamsak kik ding hi.
Ka Pasian aw, na thumannate hangin kei zong harp lasakna tawh nangmah kong phat ding hi; Israelte’ Siangtho Pa aw, laiza lasakna tawh nangmah phatna ka sa ding hi.
Nangmah phatna ka sak ciangin nuam-in ka awng ding hi; nangma hotkhiatsa ka nuntakna zong nuam-in awng ding hi.
Keima siat nading a zongte zahhuai-in kiminsia-sak khin ahih ciangin sunthapai-in thuman tawh nong huhna ka gengen ding hi.
